mainEntity.name: When should I engage a contractor for pre-construction planning?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should engage a contractor for pre-construction planning as early as possible, ideally once you have a general idea of your project's scope and goals. Engaging Hometelligent Inc. early allows us to provide valuable input on design feasibility, cost-saving alternatives, and potential construction challenges before plans are finalized. This early involvement helps optimize the decision-making process, ensuring that the design aligns with your budget and constructability requirements from the outset, saving time and resources later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Engage a contractor for pre-construction planning early, once you have project goals. This allows for input on feasibility and cost-saving, optimizing design and budget.
